scope: A0 whole-cohort development synthesis only; no completion; no independent confirmation
additional_round_rule: No second scientific revision scheduled in this bounded run; numerical/interface repairs in new version retained, not target feedback
numerical_calibration_budget: Equal branch allowance: at most three examined structures and nine unique structure/seed source cohorts, including rejected ordinary structures; three fixed seeds per structure; initial allowance three. Controller final-structure source checks reuse scheduled seeds within the allowance. Every structure and evaluated seed is logged.
selection: Final scheduled source-valid candidate; no selection by target or seed. Failed final draws retained, never replaced.
source_compatibility_rule: Schema/key/support/count/reproducibility/input-preservation mandatory. Marginal envelope descriptive, not equivalence or hidden significance. Retained source discrepancies reported without target-based exclusion.
whole_cohort_inference: Separate cohorts and scenarios only; no row stacking, Rubin pooling, mixture-probability interpretation, or synthetic-patient sample-size inflation.
baseline: One fixed Gaussian-copula statistical family with three sensitivity contexts rho=0/.4/.8 in fixed order, 7/7/6 draws total; PSD shared-person factor kernel, independent endpoint factors; positive lognormal/bounded beta/gamma margins; never fit or select by target

model_metadata.latency: controller timestamps only; not isolated model inference latency

isolation: Fresh subagents fork_turns=none; delivered path allowlist; procedural not adversarial filesystem sandbox.
metrics: unsupported confident synthetic result when reference CI overlaps null
paired change SD ratio and paired-r error
claims: Target marginal matching is reconstruction, never method success; no clinical equivalence margins invented; no superiority claim from 3 development cases.
prelaunch_amendment: Independent source audit corrections before any builder or target analysis; original freeze and source snapshots preserved under amendments/prelaunch_v1_snapshot. Baseline-only enrollment support clarified in v3, before builders.
final_inventory_gate: Before reference analysis opens, require exactly 18 paired Agent plus 3 statistical final manifests; each requests 20 draws, expected seeds, immutable candidate/artifact hashes, identical parent inputs. Duplicate repaired finals cause hard stop; no target-based selection.
reporting_granularity: Per case, lineage, policy, scenario, validation role, family, analysis and term. Never combine raw-unit absolute errors across different endpoints or proxy families.
direction_rule: Direction agreement is applicable only when the reference interval excludes zero; unresolved reference signed point estimates do not establish scientific direction.
scenario_disagreement_rule: Prespecified empirical modal evidence-state set difference between scenarios, retaining all state frequencies plus median and range of estimates. Finite Monte Carlo variation can contribute; this is descriptive sensitivity, not proof of structural effects.
paired_policy_comparison: Ordinary branch displayed beside each proposed scenario from the identical initial lineage; no pooled proposed effect, best-scenario selection, posterior mixture or independent-lineage inflation.
baseline_support: Ross weight<=180kg at baseline from enrollment eligibility; only positive support at postbaseline visits. Statistical baseline sampler clips extreme baseline tail at180 and reports marginal diagnostics.
